description: Exact targeted profile of all-nonempty versus empty-essential K6 Hall branches on the pinned 805-graph residue.

semantics.all_nonempty_branch: explicitly searched first and never discarded
semantics.allowed_defects: upper bounds; allowed coordinates may be zero
semantics.arithmetic: exact integer and bit-mask logic only
semantics.candidate_nonedges: unconstrained and may be unit; a candidate nonedge is used only as permission for the branch-forced non-unit opposite pair
semantics.empty_essential: every state surviving this necessary Hall/opposite-apex relaxation contains at least one empty defect
semantics.promotion_apex: appears in at least one surviving state of an empty-essential seed
semantics.surviving_state: necessary relaxation only, not a realization
semantics.two_empty_vertices: opposite common K6 neighbours with squared distance 7/3, so their pair cannot be a required unit edge
